description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Fire] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Dualcast Fire 1], [Fire +30% Boost 1] and [Quick Cast 1]/[Dualcast Fire 2], [Fire +30% Boost 2] and [Quick Cast 2]/[Dualcast Fire 3], [Fire +50% Boost 3] and [Quick Cast 3] to the user if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF12 allies are alive

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time
